first.rationale: Simplified onboarding is the only candidate with evidence of improving both completion and early adoption, directly matching both current declines. Verify its complex-workspace churn risk and compare the strength of activation-messaging evidence before committing. If run, restrict the test to self-serve, non-complex workspaces and retain the full flow for complex accounts. Promotional pricing is not preferred despite competitive pressure because prior gains came with materially worse 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment on in-product activation messaging. The verified evidence directly matches the 6% activation decline, showing activation +6%, week-one engagement +11%, and no observed downstream value penalty (30-day retention +1%). Shortened onboarding could improve the 4% completion decline, but its verified 60-day churn increase in complex-workspace accounts creates greater segmentation and long-term revenue risk. Promotional pricing is also unsuitable because prior retention harm conflicts with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective.
